answer: Cross-Attested Derivation Ledger. Each identity is seeded by a unique on-chain entropy draw; peers must attest the draw's ocean of randomness independently. Duplicates collide on overlapping attestations, revealing shared entropy across the bridge of records. Any identity tied to a merged entropy trace pays a saffron-flagged forfeit: its full derivation deposit plus a re-derivation surcharge, making each fake clone cost roughly double a genuine registration.
